channel.title: The Deal Desk
channel.description: A daily corporate finance podcast for students preparing for investment banking interviews. Each episode teaches one concept through a real deal, drills the interview questions you'll be asked, covers a real deal from the past week and ends with a five-question quiz. Marco, an M&A banker, explains; Sofia, a first-year student, asks the questions you would. AI-voiced: Marco and Sofia are fictional characters with AI-generated voices, and the scripts are written with AI and checked against public sources. Not investment advice.

item.title: 12. Precedent transactions, and the price of control
item.description: Spire Healthcare's buyers offered a sixty-six percent premium. Or a twenty-nine percent premium. Same offer, same day. The difference is the whole lesson. Transcript, visuals and quiz: https://llpcll.github.io/deal-desk/episode-12/ AI-voiced: Marco and Sofia are fictional characters with AI-generated voices.
